The FI values reuse frozen atlas results; the seven-factor family is secondary and sensitivity-only.
The q-value denominators differ by column. No plotted pattern establishes independent replication, local sharing, or which frailty dimension drives overlap.
See the source-data TSV for estimates, SEs, P values, family labels, overlap status and interpretation limits.
